title: A Visit Across the Hall
context: 新搬来的 Nina 去拜访对门的 Sam，归还误送的信，并约好在楼道聊聊。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Hello, I live across the hall. I think this letter is yours.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我住在对门。我想这封信是你的。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Thanks for bringing it over. I am Sam. You just moved in, right?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你送过来。我叫 Sam。你刚搬来，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm Nina. The mail carrier put it in my box by mistake.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我叫 Nina。送信员误把它放进我的信箱了。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I'm glad it reached me. How are you settling in?
dialogue.zh: 幸好它送到了。你安顿得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Pretty well, although I'm still looking for the laundry room.
dialogue.zh: 还不错，不过我还在找洗衣房。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: It is downstairs, past the elevator and on the left.
dialogue.zh: 它在楼下，过了电梯后在左边。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: That helps. Is this a good time to ask about the building?
dialogue.zh: 这下明白了。现在方便问问楼里的情况吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I have a call in a few minutes, but I'm free afterward.
dialogue.zh: 我几分钟后有个电话，不过之后有空。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: No problem. I can come back later this evening.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我今晚晚些时候可以再过来。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: That would be nice. We can chat in the hallway around seven.
dialogue.zh: 好啊。我们可以七点左右在楼道里聊聊。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I will see you then. Thanks for pointing me in the right direction.
dialogue.zh: 那时见。谢谢你给我指路。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: My pleasure, Nina. Welcome to the building!
dialogue.zh: 不客气，Nina。欢迎搬到这栋楼！

expressions.example: Our new neighbor lives across the hall.
I took your pen by mistake.
It took me a week to settle in.

expressions.zh: 现在方便吗？用于先确认对方是否有空。
expressions.example: Is this a good time to talk about the schedule?

expressions.en: point someone in the right direction
expressions.zh: 为某人指明方向或提供线索。
expressions.example: The receptionist pointed me in the right direction.

pronunciation: hall 的元音要拉开，结尾有清晰的 l；settling 的重音在第一个音节 SET。

practice.title: Part 1 · Neighbors
practice.prompt: How do you usually get to know a new neighbor?
practice.answer: I usually introduce myself when we meet in the hallway. A short conversation about the building is an easy way to start.

practice.title: Part 2 · Meeting someone new
practice.prompt: Describe a time you met a new neighbor. Say where you met, what you talked about, and how you felt.
practice.answer: When I moved into my apartment, I met a neighbor while checking my mailbox. I introduced myself and asked where to leave cardboard boxes. She showed me the room downstairs and told me her name. We talked for a few minutes about the neighborhood. I felt less nervous afterward because I knew someone I could say hello to. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Neighborly connections
practice.prompt: Why might it be difficult for neighbors to get to know one another?
practice.answer: People may have different schedules and rarely meet. A shared space can make short conversations easier, though everyone also needs privacy.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读送信和约时间的句子，再练习向邻居说明误收到的物品。
practice.answer: Hello, I live next door. This package was left at my door by mistake. Is this a good time to give it to you?
